overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried Aloe Vera Powder for B2B supply and export. It is made in India from fresh aloe vera leaves and processed through a controlled 6-step method: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. The powder is offered in 80-100 mesh form with moisture at ≤ 5.0%.

We support bulk orders, OEM projects, and private label requirements. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and samples on request. Standard packaging options include 25 kg bags or HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars. Custom mesh and packaging can also be arranged on request.
